findings.note: The dedication's 4 pyrotechnic vials were a bare counter (src/rules/classResources.ts, id 'versatile-vials', feat 'firework-technician-dedication') with no item anywhere in the items bucket, so the archetype's whole point — throwing them as bombs — had nothing to throw. Modelled field-for-field on the shipped items/versatile-vial, with acid swapped for fire exactly as feat-8528 prints. No aonId: AoN has no equipment page for this vial — it is defined inside the dedication's own text — and pointing an item's aonId at a feat doc would build a broken Equipment.aspx link. VERIFIER FIX: the proposal's second half — "point the dedication's vial counter at that item id so the 4 daily vials become throwable rows" — was reported as impossible (ClassResource has no item field) and is not: `grantsItems` is the existing lane for "a record HANDS you this item" (read by buildCharacter's granted-items walk, src/rules/build.ts:7802, off FEATS as well as class features), scripts/data/trust-approvals.json #13 approves exactly `grantsItems` on exactly this record, and work/.wg-diff-all.json has their row encoding `grantsItem` for it. Measured on a built 2nd-level fighter with the dedication: 4 vials in the pack labelled "Firework Technician Dedication", none without the row.

findings.note: ⚠ The proposal's "drop the spellSlotBonus entirely" is the one thing that must NOT be done, and I did not do it. Two readers are keyed on the field's PRESENCE: (a) src/rules/build.ts ~4520 and ~4658 stand the hard-coded legacy fallback `magusStudiousSpells(level)` down only `if (content.classFeatures['studious-spells']?.spellSlotBonus?.restricted)` — delete the field and a built magus gets the 2021 two auto-prepared slots back, the exact behaviour the finding removes; (b) `bookGrantedSpellIds` (build.ts ~3293) reads the spellbook additions OUT of that same restricted grant, so deleting it also deletes "Add any studious spell you gain to your spellbook". So the field STAYS and the SLOTS go, by emptying every ladder step's byRank — which is not an invention: all eight magus hybrid-study options in classes/magus.subclass already ship exactly this shape ({level, byRank:{}, addSpells:[…]}) for their per-study studious spell, and resolveRestrictedSlots() produces zero slots from an empty byRank while its addSpells still accumulate. sure-strike and water-breathing leave the list (they are not in the 2026 feature). The free-action Arcane Cascade rider gets a recordMarks entry on the actions/arcane-cascade row — the DATA twin of RECORD_MARKERS, walked for owned class features by recordMarksFor() in src/rules/explain.ts — so the rider reaches the player's Arcane Cascade action instead of living only in prose. No descRefs row: the shipped ref list already carries Gecko Grip / Haste / Fly, and the 22 hybrid-study labels it also carries are inert once they leave the text (RichText builds its regex from the labels and simply never matches them).
